```{r}
cat("Reading broccoli output file.. .\n")
# Read the file with two columns: OG_name and protein_names
broccoli_file <- "/home/data/Ruijie/workplace/broccoli/Metazoa_genome_fix_plut_ahya/results/Metazoa_genome_fix_ahya_plut/dir_step3/orthologous_groups.txt"
df <- read.table(broccoli_file, 
                header = TRUE, 
                sep = "\t", 
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                comment.char = "",
                quote = "")

cat(sprintf("Read %d orthogroups\n", nrow(df)))
```

```{r}
cat("Converting to long format.. .\n")
# Split protein_names by space and create one row per protein
df_long <- df %>%
    separate_rows(protein_names, sep = "\\s+") %>%
    filter(protein_names != "")
colnames(df_long)= c("orthogroup","protein_name")
```

```{r}
files <- list.files("/home/data/Ruijie/workplace/broccoli/Metazoa_genome_fix_plut_ahya/results/Metazoa_genome_fix_ahya_plut",
                    pattern = "_renamed_cleaned.longest\\.fasta$")
sps_list <- sub("_renamed_cleaned.longest\\.fasta$", "", files)

# Create a regex pattern from species list
species_pattern <- paste0("^(", paste(sps_list, collapse = "|"), ")_")
# Extract species from protein name
df_long <- df_long %>%
mutate(
    species = str_extract(protein_name, species_pattern),
    species = str_remove(species, "_$")
) %>%# Filter to keep only proteins from species in the list
filter(! is.na(species))
  
# Format orthogroup names (OG_1 -> OG: 000001)
df_long <- df_long %>%
mutate(
    orthogroup_num = as.numeric(str_extract(orthogroup, "\\d+$")),
    orthogroup = sprintf("OG:%06d", orthogroup_num)
) %>%
select(-orthogroup_num)
```

```{r}
# Remove species prefix and . p* suffix from protein names
df_long <- df_long %>%
mutate(
    # Remove species prefix (e.g., "Spis_")
    temp_name = str_remove(protein_name, paste0("^", species, "_")),
    # Remove .p1, .p2, etc. suffix
    transcript = str_remove(temp_name, "\\.p\\d+$")
) %>%
select(-temp_name)
#fix Ffun for further mapping
#df_long$transcript[df_long$species=="Fspp"]<- sub("Ffun_", "", df_long$transcript[df_long$species=="Fspp"])
```

```{r}
gtf_suffix = "_long.annot.gtf"
gtf_dir = "./reference_gtf_Metazoa/"
gtf_sps_files <- list.files(gtf_dir, pattern = "_long.annot\\.gtf$")
gtf_sps<- sub("_long.annot\\.gtf$", "", gtf_sps_files)
ungtf_sps<- setdiff(sps_list, gtf_sps)
common_sps<- intersect(sps_list, gtf_sps)
print(ungtf_sps)
df_long$gene<-NA
# Read all GTF files
for (species in common_sps) {
cat(sprintf("\nReading GTF for %s...\n", species))

gtf_file <- file.path(gtf_dir, paste0(species, gtf_suffix))

if (!file.exists(gtf_file)) {
    warning(sprintf("GTF file not found:  %s", gtf_file))
    next
}
mapping <- rtracklayer::import(gtf_file)
transcript_to_gene <- dic_from_vecs(mapping$transcript_id, mapping$gene_id)
df_long$gene[df_long$species == species] <- transcript_to_gene[df_long$transcript[df_long$species == species]]

if (sum(is.na(df_long$gene[df_long$species == species])) == sum(df_long$species == species)){
    warning(sprintf("Species %s failed in transcrit, switch to protein", species))
    prot_to_gene<-dic_from_vecs(mapping$protein_id[!is.na(mapping$protein_id)], mapping$gene_id[!is.na(mapping$protein_id)])
    df_long$gene[df_long$species == species] <- prot_to_gene[df_long$transcript[df_long$species == species]]
    }
message(sprintf("Species %s: %d total genes", species, sum(df_long$species == species)))
message(sprintf("Species %s: %d genes unmapped", species, sum(is.na(df_long$gene[df_long$species == species]))))

message(sprintf("Fixing gene names for species %s", species))
df_long$gene[df_long$species == species] <- fix_gene_name(df_long$gene[df_long$species == species], paste0(species, "_"))
}
for(species in ungtf_sps){
    message(sprintf("Species %s has no GTF file, skipping...", species))
    df_long$gene[df_long$species == species] <- fix_gene_name(df_long$transcript[df_long$species == species], paste0(species, "_"))
}
for(species in sps_list){
    df_long$gene_name[df_long$species == species] <- sub(paste0(species, "_"),"", df_long$gene[df_long$species == species])
} 
```

```{r}
mmus_genes <- df_long %>%
  filter(species == "Mmus") %>%
  group_by(orthogroup) %>%
  arrange(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(mmus_gene_name = paste(unique(gene_name), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop")
df_long <- df_long %>%
  left_join(mmus_genes, by = "orthogroup") %>%
  mutate(orthogroup_name = ifelse(! is.na(mmus_gene_name), mmus_gene_name, orthogroup)) %>%
  select(-mmus_gene_name)

df_final <- df_long %>%
    select(orthogroup, species, gene, transcript, gene_name, orthogroup_name) %>%
    arrange(orthogroup, species, gene, transcript, gene_name, orthogroup_name)

df_final_cleaned <- df_final %>%
    mutate(
        orthogroup_name = if_else(
            grepl("^OG:\\d+$", orthogroup_name),
            NA_character_,
            orthogroup_name
        )
    )

write.table(df_final_cleaned, 
              file = "./Metazoa_all_genome_260426/orthogroup_conservation.csv", 
              sep = "\t", 
              row.names = FALSE, 
              quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
mus_gtf<- rtracklayer::import("./reference_gtf_Metazoa/Mmus_long.annot.gtf")
transcript_to_gene <- dic_from_vecs(mus_gtf$transcript_id, mus_gtf$gene_id)
prot_to_gene<-dic_from_vecs(mus_gtf$protein_id[!is.na(mus_gtf$protein_id)], mus_gtf$gene_id[!is.na(mus_gtf$protein_id)])
mus_protein<- unique(mus_gtf$protein_id[!is.na(mus_gtf$protein_id)])
mus_dic <- data.frame(
    protein_id = mus_protein,
    gene_id = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
mus_dic$gene_id <- prot_to_gene[mus_dic$protein_id]
mus_dic$protein_id<- fix_gene_name(mus_dic$protein_id, "Mmus_")
write.table(
    mus_dic,
    file = "./Metazoa_all_genome_260426/mus_gene_names.csv",
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = FALSE
)
```
